title: Cooked Dog / Dog Closing His Eyes
description: An older brown chocolate Labrador dog closes his eyes halfway in warm golden sunset light, facing left with a resigned expression. Used when you are cooked, done for, in trouble, doomed or overwhelmed and quietly accept your fate. Also captures taking a deep breath, trying to stay calm, surrendering, exhausted acceptance and pretending everything is okay.

title: Chill Guy
description: A brown cartoon dog stands casually with his hands in his pockets, wearing a gray sweater and jeans in a grassy field at sunset. The chill guy stays relaxed, laid back, nonchalant and unbothered while everyone else panics or argues. Used for low stakes confidence, minding your own business and acting cool about a chaotic situation.

title: Let Him Cook
description: Woody from Toy Story holds an arm out in front of Sora from Kingdom Hearts, with the words let him cook. A reaction asking everyone to hold on and let someone cook: give them time to explain an idea, finish their plan or prove that an unlikely approach will work. Often used when someone is onto something, making a good point or deserves a chance before being interrupted.

title: Sad Hamster
description: A tiny wide eyed hamster looks helpless and sad. Used for feeling fragile, overwhelmed by a small inconvenience, nervous about asking a favor, being broke, having hurt feelings or needing gentle reassurance. An exaggerated cute reaction to disappointment and everyday struggles.

title: Absolute Cinema
description: A black and white photograph of film director Martin Scorsese holding both hands up. The absolute cinema reaction praises something as a masterpiece, peak storytelling, incredible filmmaking or a beautifully dramatic moment, sometimes sarcastically after an absurd turn of events.

title: Blue Smurf Cat
description: A small blue catlike creature with a mushroom shaped head walks through a forest carrying a stick. The Smurf cat is a surreal whimsical internet reaction, often called Shailushai, used for absurd humor, strange little creatures, wandering on an adventure and inexplicable viral jokes.

title: Huh Cat
description: A wide eyed white cat with a black patch on top of its head with its mouth slightly open gives a startled questioning look. The huh cat reaction expresses confusion, not understanding what someone just said, asking them to repeat themselves or being baffled by a strange statement. This is a still image of the reaction.

title: Shocked Black Guy
description: A close up of a man with extremely wide eyes and an open mouth, with both hands on his head, frozen in surprise. Used for being stunned, speechless or in disbelief after hearing shocking news, noticing something outrageous or realizing an unexpected fact.

title: Math Lady / Confused Lady
description: A woman squints with a confused expression while mathematical equations float around her face. Used when mentally calculating, overthinking, trying to understand a complicated explanation or working out something that does not add up.
